title: Parsa Venkateshwar Rao Jr | Real Problems Of Neet Go Deeper Than Dealing With Wangchuk’s Fast
description: This has been the presidential style of Prime Minister Modi’s governance. Ignore the questions arising from the government’s failures and talk about other things, as though the problems are imaginary. The government has succeeded in pulling the wool over the eyes of the people. Manipulation and brainwashing fail to describe the act of deception adequately
